strongest_angle: Examine how Procore's Magpie 3.0 reasoning engine scored 78 percent on a fixed benchmark of 200 construction tasks, outperforming general AI models by 18 percentage points across schedule, change, and drawing work.

key_facts.fact: Procore's Magpie 3.0 reasoning engine completed 78 percent of a fixed benchmark consisting of 200 construction tasks.
Procore reported that Magpie 3.0 scored 18 percentage points higher than the closest general-purpose frontier model on the construction task benchmark.

The 200-plus construction tasks in the benchmark were derived from questions asked by site managers, project managers, and project executives regarding RFIs, submittals, drawings, schedules, and changes.
The California Centre for Construction Education at Cal Poly independently reviewed the benchmark used to test Procore AI with Magpie 3.0.

quotes.text: We tested it on 200+ real tasks from practicing site managers, project managers and executives, with the benchmark reviewed independently by Cal Poly's California Centre for Construction Education.
quotes.speaker: Preeya Selvarajah
